fields.v: Yes (1): inclusion and exclusion criteria stated (Table 3: IC1-IC3, EC1-EC3)
fields.quote: Tabla 3 summarizes the inclusion and exclusion criteria applied to the search results.
fields.why: The paper describes its search (four databases plus grey literature) and its selection criteria, which under the 2026-11-23 rule (§5) makes it assessable with DARE, although the author kept Q1-Q13 because the main nature is conceptual.
fields.doubt: O artigo descreve fontes (4 bases + literatura cinzenta) e critérios IC/EC (§3.2-3.4, pág. 9-10). Pela regra de 23-11, isso basta para DARE. Decide se a componente de revisão (MLR) é avaliada com DARE ou se manténs Q1-Q13 por a natureza principal ser conceptual; se aceitares, DARE1 = Sim.

fields.v: Partly (0.5): four databases (IEEE Xplore, ACM DL, Scopus, arXiv) plus grey literature, but a single broad search string and grey-literature selection not quantified
fields.quote: The main academic databases for Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence—IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, Scopus, and arXiv—were queried.
fields.why: If DARE applies (see DARE1), search coverage is four databases plus grey literature with one broad string, which fits Partly.
fields.doubt: Só relevante se aplicares DARE (ver DARE1). Pesquisa em 4 bases mais literatura cinzenta, mas com uma única expressão ("Agentic Software Engineering") e sem contagens da literatura cinzenta (pág. 9). Proposta: Parcial.

fields.v: Partly (0.5): quality judged by venue impact (JCR) for academic sources and some Garousi et al. criteria for grey literature; no per-study assessment reported
fields.quote: For traditional academic sources, the impact of publication in the JCR index or texts endorsed by the scientific community has been considered.
fields.why: If DARE applies (see DARE1), quality assessment exists but is by venue and source reputation only, which fits Partly.
fields.doubt: Só relevante se aplicares DARE (ver DARE1). A qualidade foi avaliada pelo índice JCR e por alguns critérios de Garousi para a literatura cinzenta, sem avaliação por estudo (pág. 10). Proposta: Parcial.

fields.v: Partly (0.5): included studies not listed in the paper (only in the Zenodo package); Table 4 gives representative traceability only
fields.quote: The table is representative rather than exhaustive; the full extraction matrix and source-selection material are provided in the replication package.
fields.why: If DARE applies (see DARE1), the included studies are described only in summary in the paper, which fits Partly.
fields.doubt: Só relevante se aplicares DARE (ver DARE1). Os estudos incluídos não são listados no artigo, só no pacote Zenodo; a Tabela 4 é apenas representativa (pág. 26-27). Proposta: Parcial.
